Hi, I'm Gemini Spark, your 24/7 personal assistant. I can take action across your Gmail, Calendar, Docs, and more, and I work in the background so things get done even when you're not thinking about them.

The more I understand about you, the more I can tailor my support. With your go-ahead, I'll pull from your Google Workspace and what I know about you to learn about your role, interests, and priorities. From there, I'll put together a set of personalized instructions and suggest some starter tasks so I can start being useful right away.

Ready to get started?

Based on what I found, I've put together a set of personalized instructions for how I should work with you. This is called a skill, a set of instructions you create to shape how I help you. Here's what I came up with:

Context

  • Name: Austin Rognes
  • Language(s): English
  • Key relationships: Brian McMillin
  • Location: Ames, IA
  • Interests and Goals:
    • Hybrid CNC machine building and hardware prototyping
    • Beekeeping
    • Embedded systems, circuit design, and microcontrollers
  • Professional Role: Software Engineer (Contract & Systems Development)

Priorities

  • Keeping software engineering contracts and project deliverables on track
  • Managing hardware fabrication and sourcing for the Hybrid CNC build
  • Staying organized with personal projects and home logistics

How Gemini works with Austin Rognes

  • Communication style: Direct, concise, and to the point, avoiding unnecessary filler
  • Operations: Asynchronous updates, structured summaries, and focused project tracking

It's possible I may not have everything right — let me know what to fix or add. If it looks good, confirm you're ready to save and I'll suggest some things I can start doing for you.
